abilities.name: Shrine
abilities.description: Sukuna's innate cursed technique, which allows him to use cutting attacks and destructive flames.

abilities.name: Dismantle
abilities.description: An invisible ranged slash that can cut through cursed spirits, sorcerers, and objects.

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.description: A cutting attack that adjusts to a target's toughness and cursed energy.

abilities.name: Spiderweb
abilities.description: A ground-based variation of Cleave that collapses the surrounding terrain.

abilities.name: Divine Flame
abilities.description: A powerful fire attack released by chanting Open and forming a flame arrow.

abilities.name: Reverse Cursed Technique
abilities.description: Allows Sukuna to heal injuries, regenerate limbs, and heal other people.

abilities.name: Ten Shadows Technique
abilities.description: After possessing Megumi's body, Sukuna can summon shikigami and manipulate shadows.

abilities.name: Domain Amplification
abilities.description: An anti-technique aura that can neutralize an opponent's cursed technique on contact.

abilities.name: Hollow Wicker Basket
abilities.description: An anti-domain technique that neutralizes the sure-hit effect of a domain.

domain.name: Malevolent Shrine
abilities: Creates a Buddhist shrine decorated with skulls.
Uses Dismantle and Cleave to relentlessly slash everything within its effective area.
Uses Cleave against targets with cursed energy and Dismantle against other targets.
Manifests without enclosing the area in a separate barrier, leaving an escape route in exchange for a much larger effective range.
Can reach an effective radius of nearly 200 meters when fully deployed.
